# Sal's Galaxy Zone — Three Locations

```
   ______________________________________________
  |  SAL'S  GALAXY  ZONE  ·  EST. 1978, PORTLAND |
  |``````````````````````````````````````````````|
  |   [No.1]        [No.2]         [No.3]        |
  |  AUG 2025      MAR 2026       JUL 2026       |
  |  ________      ________       ________       |
  | |  OPEN  |    |  OPEN  |     |  OPEN  |      |
  | |________|    |________|     |________|      |
  |______________________________________________|
```

One landing page, three complete arcades — every era of the Galaxy Zone,
still running.

**🕹️ Play it live: [galaxyzonearcade.com](https://galaxyzonearcade.com/)**

| Location | Era | Built with | Where |
|---|---|---|---|
| No. 1 — The Original | Aug 2025 | Claude (model lost to the register tape) | `arcades/2025-08/` |
| No. 2 — The Second Location | Mar 2026 | Claude Opus 4.6 | `arcades/2026-03/` |
| No. 3 — The Remodel ★ flagship | Jul 2026 | Claude Fable | `arcades/2026-07/` |

## Run it

Open `index.html` — everything works straight from the file system, all three
locations. (Location No. 2 was built in the ES-modules era; its copy here was
converted to classic scripts so it runs from `file://` like the others.)
Prefer a local server? `./start.sh` serves it all on http://localhost:8080.

## What's in each arcade

- **No. 1 (2025)** — the original 15 games, one afternoon of vibe coding.
  Preserved exactly as the master branch shipped it.
- **No. 2 (2026-03)** — 15 rebuilt games plus something locked in the back
  room, on an early shared engine. Preserved as built.
- **No. 3 (2026-07)** — the full remodel: 16 cabinets on one engine
  (`engine/gz-*.js`), delta-time physics, touch controls, synthesized audio,
  achievements, the story of Sal "Pixel" Martinez — and a crate that arrived
  on a rainy Tuesday. See `arcades/2026-07/README.md` for details.

— Sal 'Pixel' Martinez, Keeper of the High Score
